$comment: flotilla config — device route + privilege mode. shizuku_mode is DEFAULT: shizuku_server runs as shell uid (full privileges, survives wireless-adb port rotation, no root needed). Falls back to plain adb when shizuku is down. FLOTILLA_CONFIG env overrides this path.

shizuku_mode.how: adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/moe.shizuku.privileged.api/start.sh (starts server as shell uid via wireless-adb run-as shell)

adb_fallback.when: shizuku_server process absent OR rish exec fails twice
adb_fallback.degrade: plain adb shell (shell uid, no elevated grants)
